headline: On November 7, 1991: Magic Johnson announces HIV diagnosis and retires
captionCards: Retired after announcing HIV-positive status on Nov 7, 1991
His return to the 1992 All-Star Game sparked national dialogue on HIV
instagramCaption:
Magic Johnson shocks the world.

On November 7, 1991, NBA star Magic Johnson announced he had contracted HIV and would retire from basketball. He played his entire career with the Los Angeles Lakers and led them to five championships during the 'Showtime' era. The surprising detail: he returned to play in the 1992 All-Star Game, winning MVP despite the controversy. His announcement challenged stigma around HIV and inspired public awareness.
